person.description: A person in the applicant's household.

partner_of.description: The first person is a partner of the second (S1 reg. 1(3), taken as a fact, O3).

shares_home.description: The two persons share accommodation as their mutual home in the qualifying week (S1 reg. 1(4)(b), taken as a fact).

home_start_dated.description: The two persons' mutual home began on the household's home start date; otherwise it began before the qualifying week (AR5).

home_ended.description: The two persons' mutual home has a last day, the household's home end date; otherwise it continues after the qualifying week (AR5).

partnership_start_dated.description: The two persons became partners on the household's partnership start date; otherwise before the qualifying week (AR5).

partnership_ended.description: The two persons' partnership has a last day, the household's partnership end date; otherwise it continues after the qualifying week (AR5).

paid_for_week.description: The benefit has been, or falls to be, paid to the person for the qualifying week.

ever_resident_ew.description: The person has a first day of ordinary residence in England and Wales.

remains_resident_ew.description: The person's ordinary residence in England and Wales has not ended.

moved_to_scotland_or_ni.description: The person has become ordinarily resident in Scotland or Northern Ireland.

in_care_setting.description: The person resides in a care home, independent hospital or Polish resettlement accommodation from the care start date, and to the care end date if the stay has one.

care_ended.description: The person's care stay has a last day, the care end date.

inpatient.description: The person is a hospital in-patient receiving free treatment, from the admission date to the discharge date.

detained_in_custody.description: The person is detained in custody from the custody start date to the release date.

under_sentence.description: The person's custody is under a sentence imposed by a court.

claimed.description: The person made a claim for the winter fuel payment on the claim date.

paid_without_claim.description: The person is paid without a claim (S1 reg. 5(1)).

reached_pa.description: R2: the person reached pensionable age in or before the qualifying week.

reached_80.description: The person reached the age of 80 in or before the qualifying week.

resident_in_week.description: R3: the person is ordinarily resident in England or Wales on a day of the qualifying week.

has_rb.description: R4: a relevant benefit has been, or falls to be, paid to the person for the qualifying week.

in_residential_care.description: R5: the person is in residential care (S1 reg. 1(4)(a)).

lives_with.description: R6: the first person lives with the second (S1 reg. 1(4)(b)).

home_throughout.description: R7a: the two persons share their mutual home on every day of the qualifying week (AR7).

partners_throughout.description: R7b: the first person is a partner of the second on every day of the qualifying week (AR7).

partner_at_home.description: R14a: on one day of the qualifying week, the first person is a partner of the second and they share a mutual home (AR8).

excluded_partner_benefit.description: R7: S1 reg. 4(2)(a) applies to the person.

excluded_hospital.description: R8: S1 reg. 4(2)(b) applies to the person.

excluded_custody.description: R9: S1 reg. 4(2)(c) applies to the person.

excluded_care_benefit.description: R10: S1 reg. 4(3) applies to the person.

excluded_moved.description: R11: S1 reg. 4(4) applies to the person.

excluded_no_claim.description: R12: S1 reg. 4(5) applies to the person.

excluded.description: R13: some exclusion in S1 reg. 4(2) to (5) applies to the person.

entitled.description: R13: the person is entitled to a winter fuel payment for winter 2026 to 2027.

recovered.description: R16: HMRC takes the payment back from the person (S2).

housemate.description: The one other person H in P's household, if any.

income_related_esa.description: The benefit income-related employment and support allowance.
